summary: Frontend-only test of new 'Sold-Out Toggle' feature on /admin/menu. All 8 requested behaviors verified working end-to-end via Playwright against public preview URL: admin login, toggle button visibility/testid, optimistic UI update (Rupture->Dispo label, opacity-60 dim, Rupture stamp overlay, Off badge), correct French success toasts ('Cheese marqué en rupture' / 'Cheese de nouveau disponible'), backend persistence after page reload (PUT /api/admin/menu/{id} returned 200 and state survived reload), edit modal NOT opened by the quick toggle, pre-existing Edit modal + 'Disponible' checkbox still functional.

issues: React hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' originating from MenuAdmin.jsx category <select> options (line 124). Caused by editor tooling injecting <span data-ve-dynamic> wrappers inside <option>. Non-blocking but pollutes console and can cause hydration mismatches.

action_items: (Low priority) Investigate the '<span> inside <option>' hydration warning in MenuAdmin.jsx category dropdown (options rendered from cats array). It appears to be caused by the visual-editor x-ve-dynamic wrapper spans; safe to ignore if it only occurs in dev/preview build.
critical_code_review_comments: toggleAvailable() in MenuAdmin.jsx correctly implements optimistic update with revert-on-error and success/error toasts - good pattern.

The grayscale class is applied to the element, so if the item image fails to load the visual grayscale effect will not appear (only the opacity dim + Rupture stamp + Off badge will). This is acceptable but worth noting.
PUT payload sends only {available: nextAvailable}; backend MenuItemUpdate handles partial update correctly (verified via network trace: 200 response and reload persistence).
seed_data_creation: None - used existing menu items (toggled 'Cheese' off then back on, final state = available).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sold-out quick-toggle on /admin/menu is fully working (UI + persistence + toasts). Item toggled during test: 'Cheese' (id 3f2420ac-87de-4b26-b0cc-fc57ea692338) - left in AVAILABLE state after test. Backend PUT /api/admin/menu/{id} with partial {available: bool} confirmed working via network logs. Only observation is a pre-existing React hydration warning from visual-editor span wrappers inside <option> elements; unrelated to the sold-out feature.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found in the tested feature.
